title.narrative: Resilient and Sustainable Livelihoods Transformation Project Ver 2

description.narrative: The Resilient and Sustainable Livelihoods Transformation (RESULT) Project is implemented by the African Institute of Corporate Citizenship (AICC) in the Salima District of Malawi. The project's main purpose is to build resilient livelihoods, enhance food security, and promote gender equality by strengthening civil society engagement, diversifying incomes through climate-smart agriculture (e.g., rice, legumes, horticulture, and small-scale irrigation), and advancing women's economic empowerment. Key activities include establishing grassroots advocacy platforms, promoting Village Savings and Loan Associations (VSLAs), and using lead farmers for mentorship. The project targets 2,000 women and 500 men directly (and 11,250 indirectly), including youth, people living with HIV/AIDS, and persons with disabilities, aiming to increase their resilience and support their transition toward self-reliance amid economic, climate, and governance challenges in Malawi.
